F4.empty.reason: Questions are returned despite the complete report.

F4.only_missing.reason: The repeat result is already supplied and extra prior-state details are unnecessary.

F4.distinct.reason: Prior state, repeat action and repeat result are separate requests.

F4.grounded.reason: No unsupported feature, outcome or diagnosis is asserted.

F6.coverage.reason: Actual name, performed actions and fresh-form setup are assumed rather than established.

F6.only_missing.reason: Visible results, field validity and feedback remain missing.

F6.distinct.reason: The exact resulting name repeats the preceding questions about the visible name and result.

F6.grounded.reason: The question presupposes the intended fresh form and name were actually used despite the empty observation.
